module: Auxiliary controller for airplanes: combines the pilot's inputs (rudder, ailerons, elevator) with the trims, and handles flaps and slats. It writes the results to `electrics.values` (rudder, aileron, elevator, slat, flap), which the jbeam actuators then use, and displays UI messages when a value changes.
notes: Jbeam keys read by init: `flapStart`, `slatStart`, `rudderTrimmingStart`, `aileronTrimmingStart`, `elevatorTrimmingStart` (start values, 0 by default), `trimSpeed` (0.05), `flapSpeed` (0.1), `slatSpeed` (0.1); speeds expressed as a fraction per second.

Inputs read from `input`: rudder, aileron, elevator, trimChange, trimRudder, trimAileron, trimElevator, flap, slat, flapChange, slatChange. The relative trim (`trimChange`) acts on the axis chosen by toggleTrimMode (elevator, aileron, rudder, cycling in that order).
Outputs: rudder/aileron/elevator = input + trim (not limited to [-1,1] in this file); trim, flap and slat are clamped (trim -1..1, flap and slat 0..1 for relative inputs).
No `reset` function exists: controller.reset calls init again. updateGFX assumes init has already initialized `trimming`.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: applies the inputs and trims to the electrics rudder, aileron, elevator, updates flap and slat (absolute input value if it changed, otherwise relative adjustment), and displays a UI message when a trim, the flaps or the slats vary by more than 0.005.

toggleTrimMode.desc: Switches to the next trim axis (elevator, aileron, rudder) and announces it with a UI message.

setTrimValue.desc: Directly sets the trim value of an axis (no effect if the axis is unknown).

init.desc: Initializes the electrics, the start values of flaps/slats/trims and the speeds from the jbeam.
